production_source_comparison.interpretation: 292 runtime/build paths checked: 290 are unchanged; only four screenshot-copy commands in the container script and the standalone evidence workflow differ. The supplementary workflow independently verifies unchanged application and test inputs. Eight historical user extensions are retained separately. Post-build original-instruction research and documentation are recorded separately.

limits: No real hardware setting, voltage, frequency or stability measurement has been verified.

All-core curve is restricted to Shimada family 1Ah/model 08h and PCI 1022:153a/BDF 0. It compares the full capability word and sends one six-argument RSMU 07 command; counts are -50..50, not millivolts.

A response of 1 is acknowledgement only. All-core readback, affected physical core count and physical mapping remain unverified. No implicit mode, VID, rails, Force/UnForce, retry or rollback is implemented.
Original Force/UnForce functions publish unverified outputs before checking response. They do not establish a CO reset or a dual-rail reset contract.
The arithmetic PM length relation does not establish physical CCD count or array offsets. Per-core/CCD layout and dual-rail hardware writes remain unresolved.
AMD PStates writes, other AMD platforms and Curve Shaper, remaining Intel server and board controls, dynamic memory/EC and broader native PM transport remain incomplete.
EL7 means Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64. Windows/macOS validate the portable core, not a full application port.
QEMU verifies module integration only; Secure Boot and actual register settings were not tested.

supplemental_gui_review.reason: The full matrix generated the new screenshots but its container script did not copy them into uploaded artifacts. Four copy commands and the standalone evidence workflow were corrected; application and test sources remained unchanged.

visual_review.method: Direct image inspection of four exported fixtures
findings: All-core input, capability and apply controls are visible on EL7 and Ubuntu 24.04.
Accepted fixtures show -25 counts and response 1 while retaining unverified per-core readback and unknown affected physical core count.
Failure fixtures show response FD, Attempted; not confirmed, and settings-may-have-changed/no-retry status.
Six result rows and the status line are visible in each 1200x1200 fixture; no successful readback or hardware effect is implied.
The original UI selects AMD_PM_LOG::set_curve_opt for all cores, then displays Applied before its later per-core queries; this is not transactional success.

The independently replayed AMD_PBO setter after its original Shimada constructor writes full 32-bit margin on F8/FC, sends A3 then 07, repeats the argument and reads response after releasing its mutex. No input clamp or completion poll is implemented.

ForceAllDLDOPsm, UnForceAllDLDOPsm and UnForceCpuVid send FD followed by 0E, 0F and 13 respectively, overwrite response registers and publish the argument before reading response. They are not a verified reset for CO 07 or rails 61.
All 60 synthetic PCI failure positions continue through each original tail. Device-search and register reads are explicit synthetic boundaries, not firmware behavior.

New GUI/CLI uses independently corroborated Shimada RSMU 07 and low-16-bit signed CO counts only, six initialized arguments, capability comparison, identity recheck and one acknowledged command. No all-core readback or hardware effect is claimed.
Eight PM version sizes obey an arithmetic relation, but still do not provide field order or physical topology. Known default-constructor bounds/aliasing conflicts remain.
Dual rails writes, per-core/CCD telemetry layout, dynamic memory/EC and other-platform settings remain unresolved.

pm_capacity_review.interpretation: k is a byte of the version identifier, not a certified CCD count. Exact size relation 0x634+0x274*k is arithmetic only. Under an explicit hypothetical 8*k cores, k CCDs and 15/11 original rows, even a contiguous relocation after 0x634 leaves 0x68*k bytes unexplained. The original constructor falls back to 16 cores/2 CCDs for k=6. No new offset, unit, stride, ordering or physical mapping is established.

post_build_analysis.interpretation: All three new analysis regressions passed in the local full suite. An unchanged Intel TVB busy-loop case hit the emulator one-second wall-clock guard before its bounded instruction exit; both TVB tests passed immediately on targeted retry without code changes. The three Linux compiler/binutils checks were skipped locally and passed in the 134-test cloud suite at the production commit. The full local run itself is not claimed as an all-pass run.
